description: Core infrastructure: TypeScript types, Firebase initialisation, Firestore helpers, Zustand stores, i18n setup (FR/EN), React Router shell with role-based protected routes, and the seed data script. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-001's stub files — it replaces and completes them. Depends on FEAT-001 (npm packages and config must exist).
steps: Create src/types/index.ts with all shared TypeScript interfaces and enums: UserRole enum ('admin'|'serveur'|'cuisine'|'client'), OrderStatus enum ('PENDING'|'VALIDATED'|'IN_PREPARATION'|'READY'|'SERVED'|'PAID'|'REJECTED'), TableZone enum ('salle'|'paillote'|'jardin'), Table interface (id, numero: number, zone: TableZone, capacite: number, statut: 'libre'|'occupee', qrCodeUrl: string), Category interface (id, nom_fr, nom_en, ordre: number, icon: string), Product interface (id, nom_fr, nom_en, desc_fr, desc_en, prix: number, categorieId: string, imageUrl: string, disponible: boolean, orderCount: number, tags: string[]), OrderItem interface (productId, nom_fr, nom_en, prix: number, quantite: number), Order interface (id, tableId, sessionId, clientPrenom, statut: OrderStatus, createdAt: Timestamp, validatedAt?, estimatedMinutes?: number, items: OrderItem[], servedAt?, paidAt?, rejectedReason?: string), AppUser interface (id, nom, email, role: UserRole, actif: boolean).

Create src/lib/firebase.ts: initialise Firebase app using VITE_ env vars from import.meta.env. Export db (Firestore), auth (Firebase Auth), storage (Firebase Storage). Use `initializeApp`, `getFirestore`, `getAuth`, `getStorage` from modular SDK. Guard with `getApps().length` to avoid double-init.

Create src/lib/firestore.ts: export typed helper functions — getCategories() → Promise<Category[]>, getProducts(categoryId?: string) → Promise<Product[]>, getTableById(id: string) → Promise<Table|null>, createOrder(data: Omit<Order,'id'>) → Promise<string>, updateOrderStatus(id: string, patch: Partial<Order>) → Promise<void>, getOrdersByTable(tableId: string, cb: (orders: Order[]) => void) → Unsubscribe (onSnapshot), getOrdersByStatus(statuses: OrderStatus[], cb) → Unsubscribe, getAllOrders(cb) → Unsubscribe, getTables(cb) → Unsubscribe. Use Firestore modular API (`collection`, `doc`, `addDoc`, `updateDoc`, `query`, `where`, `orderBy`, `onSnapshot`, `getDocs`). Increment orderCount on product when order is validated using `increment(1)` from firestore.

Create src/store/authStore.ts: Zustand store with { user: AppUser|null, firebaseUser: User|null, loading: boolean, setUser, setFirebaseUser, setLoading, logout }. `logout` calls Firebase `signOut`. On module load call `onAuthStateChanged` and sync to store.

Create src/store/cartStore.ts: Zustand store (persisted to sessionStorage key 'cart-{tableId}') with { items: CartItem[], tableId: string|null, sessionId: string, clientPrenom: string, setTableId, setClientPrenom, addItem, removeItem, updateQuantity, clearCart, total: computed getter }. CartItem = OrderItem. sessionId is auto-generated UUID (crypto.randomUUID()) on store creation and stored in sessionStorage.
Create src/store/orderStore.ts: Zustand store with { orders: Order[], activeOrders: Order[], setOrders, updateOrder }. Used by dashboard pages to subscribe to real-time updates.

Create src/hooks/useProducts.ts: custom hook that calls getCategories() and getProducts() and returns { categories, products, loading, error }. Sorts categories by `ordre`, sorts products within each category by orderCount desc.

Create src/hooks/useOrders.ts: custom hook that accepts a filter config (role, tableId?, sessionId?) and subscribes via the appropriate firestore.ts listener. Returns { orders, loading }. Cleans up onSnapshot on unmount.
Create src/hooks/useRealtime.ts: generic wrapper — useRealtime<T>(subscribe: (cb) => Unsubscribe) → { data: T, loading }. Used internally by useOrders.

Create src/i18n/fr.json: comprehensive French translation object covering all UI strings — navigation, menu categories, order flow statuses, button labels, error messages, countdown messages, admin dashboard labels, auth forms, table zones, roles. Keys must be dot-namespaced (e.g. 'menu.search_placeholder', 'order.status.PENDING', 'admin.users.title').
Create src/i18n/en.json: same key structure as fr.json with English translations.

Create src/i18n/index.ts: initialise i18next with react-i18next plugin. Default language 'fr', fallback 'fr'. Load resources from fr.json and en.json. Detect browser language. Export i18n instance. Use `initReactI18next` and `LanguageDetector`.

Create src/components/ui/Button.tsx: accessible button with variants (primary, secondary, danger, ghost), sizes (sm, md, lg), loading state (shows Spinner), disabled state. Uses Tailwind classes with the project color palette.

Create src/components/ui/Badge.tsx: status badge component mapping OrderStatus → color (PENDING=yellow, VALIDATED=blue, IN_PREPARATION=orange, READY=green, SERVED=teal, PAID=gray, REJECTED=red). Accepts custom label override for i18n.
Create src/components/ui/Modal.tsx: accessible modal (focus trap, ESC to close, backdrop click to close). Uses Framer Motion for enter/exit animation. Accepts title, children, onClose.
Create src/components/ui/Card.tsx: simple card wrapper with optional shadow and hover effect.
Create src/components/ui/Spinner.tsx: animated loading spinner using Tailwind animate-spin.
Create src/components/ui/LanguageSwitcher.tsx: FR/EN toggle button using i18n.changeLanguage(). Persists choice to localStorage.

Create src/App.tsx: full React Router v6 BrowserRouter setup. Routes: '/' → <RootRedirect> (redirects to /table if no auth, to /serveur|/cuisine|/admin based on role if authenticated), '/login' → <LoginPage>, '/table/:tableId' → <TablePage> (public, no auth required), '/serveur' → <ProtectedRoute role='serveur'><ServeurDashboard/></ProtectedRoute>, '/cuisine' → <ProtectedRoute role='cuisine'><CuisineDashboard/></ProtectedRoute>, '/admin/*' → <ProtectedRoute role='admin'><AdminLayout/></ProtectedRoute> with nested routes for /admin, /admin/menu, /admin/tables, /admin/users, /admin/orders, /admin/reports. Create <ProtectedRoute> component that reads authStore and redirects to /login if not authenticated or wrong role. Create <AdminLayout> with sidebar navigation.

Create src/main.tsx: render <React.StrictMode><Suspense fallback={<Spinner/>}><App/></Suspense></React.StrictMode> into #root. Import './i18n' before App to ensure i18n initialises first. Import global CSS (src/index.css). Register service worker via vite-plugin-pwa's virtual module `virtual:pwa-register`.
Create src/index.css: import Tailwind directives (@tailwind base/components/utilities). Set body background to #FFF8F0 and font-family Inter.

Create src/seed/seedData.ts: async function seedFirestore() that writes all 5 categories and all menu items (Plats africains, Grillades, Boissons locales, Soft & Jus, Bières — full list from task spec) to Firestore using setDoc with deterministic IDs. Also seeds 20 tables: 8 in zone 'salle', 6 in zone 'paillote', 6 in zone 'jardin'. Each table has numero (1–20), zone, capacite (4), statut 'libre'. Wraps writes in batched writes (writeBatch). Export the function; it is NOT called on app start — an admin can invoke it from the browser console via window.seedFirestore = seedFirestore in dev mode only.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
All TypeScript interfaces and enums are used without `any` types
i18n initialises with FR as default and both fr.json and en.json load without errors
React Router renders without console errors on all defined route paths
findings: Build passes (exit 0). All 22 steps implemented: types/index.ts, firebase.ts (with multi-tab persistence), firestore.ts (typed helpers + orderCount increment), authStore/cartStore/orderStore (Zustand), useProducts/useOrders/useRealtime hooks, fr.json+en.json (all keys dot-namespaced), i18n/index.ts (i18next + LanguageDetector + react-i18next), 6 UI components (Button/Badge/Modal/Card/Spinner/LanguageSwitcher), App.tsx (full router with ProtectedRoute + AdminLayout), main.tsx (PWA register + i18n import), index.css (Tailwind directives), seedData.ts (22 products, 5 categories, 20 tables via writeBatch). Added src/vite-env.d.ts with Vite + PWA type references to fix import.meta.env errors. Installed missing i18next-browser-languagedetector@8.0.0.
